title: Red panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#e8734a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='80' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#8e2a1f' transform='rotate(20 26 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='80' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#8e2a1f' transform='rotate(-20 74 80)'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 84 Q92 82 90 68 Q88 60 80 62' fill='none' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 70 Q91 66 87 63' fill='none' stroke='#f2e0c8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='26' fill='#d8422f'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='24' r='9' fill='#8e2a1f'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='24' r='9' fill='#8e2a1f'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='24' r='5' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <path d='M27 16 L29 10 L31 16 Z' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <path d='M69 16 L71 10 L73 16 Z' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <!-- white cheek/muzzle patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='52' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='52' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <!-- forehead blaze -->
  <path d='M50 22 Q44 34 46 40 Q50 36 54 40 Q56 34 50 22 Z' fill='#f2e0c8'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#8e2a1f'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='42' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#8e2a1f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='40.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='40.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='43.5' r='0.9' fill='#aef2ff'/>
  <circle cx='60.8' cy='43.5' r='0.9' fill='#aef2ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 57 Q46 61 43 58' fill='none' stroke='#8e2a1f' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 57 Q54 61 57 58' fill='none' stroke='#8e2a1f' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
